# WB3 · Hôm nay

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · page · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`/today`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#today`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `crm-ui.js › today()`: reception list of the appointments of `DAY`, 25 per page, filters `todayStatus`, `todayDoctor`, `todayQuery`; the status tiles are `data-crm="today-status"` buttons.
- Row buttons run `PemaCRM.reception(id, status)` (check-in `arrive`, `start`, `missed`) and toast "Đã cập nhật hàng đợi".
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"}; it must show `#crm-today-search`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/today` · status: **restyle (U1)** · U step: U1
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/today` "Việc hôm nay" (owner U1); test ids: `src/app/(admin)/today/page.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/today/resolve-task-sheet.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/crm-task-view.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/assignee-options.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/today/page.tsx`

Kit components used: Button×12, Field×3, PageHeading×1, Card×1, TableShell×1, Badge×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Responsive
- 1440×900 is the reference (Frame, Layout).
- 1920×1020: no layout change
- 1280×720: no layout change
- 1024×768: .crm-reception-stats: grid 8 → 4 columns; .sidebar: width 232 → 204px
- 390×844: .page-heading: display flex → block; .crm-reception-stats: grid 8 → 4 columns; .sidebar: position fixed → static; .sidebar: width 232 → 390px; .topbar: position sticky → static · hidden: "PHÒNG KHÁM DA LIỄU", "Không gian làm việc", "Quản lý", "Phân tích", "BT", "Chủ phòng khám", "Không gian phòng khám", "/"

## Required text (keep verbatim)

## Business rules
- Status words: booked "Chưa đến" (also counts confirmed), arrived "Đang chờ", in_progress "Đang khám/điều trị", completed "Hoàn tất", cancelled "Đã hủy", missed "Vắng hẹn".
- Doctors see only their own visits and no invoice total ("Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is hidden for role doctor).

## Differences from the app design
- App I2 lists "Tổng lịch", "Đang chờ", "Hoàn tất" and a status chip row; the web has 8 reception tiles that act as filters, a doctor select, a search field and paging ("← Trước", "Sau →").

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.
- The money tile "Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is missing for the doctor role (WB4 and WB2 use other roles).
